input: Phase57-promoted leading 2D cross-fitted W20 paragraph residual; broad section/Currier/hand removed out-of-fold; 635 eligible paragraphs
evaluation: 5-fold grouped by physical leaf; logistic prediction from residual 2D only; balanced accuracy; matched label permutations within section|Currier|hand strata

quire.qualification: High-cardinality quire labels are poorly supported across grouped folds and strongly tied to physical blocks; retained as descriptive only, not a clean inferential test.

decision: No evidence that the promoted 2D residual is primarily a recto/verso or coarse physical-order nuisance representation. H58-2 is not supported by these nuisance controls. Proceed to independently grounded content annotation/test; this is not positive semantic evidence.
warning: Residual construction and Phase57 robustness remain internal to the same transcription/manuscript. Phase58A only clears the tested nuisance labels.
